summary: Fixes OIDC first sign-up failing for long picture claims: users.avatar widened to TEXT (migration applied automatically at startup); non-http(s) or >2048 char pictures are no longer stored.

statements.why: Widening column, no data loss or new exposure.

statements.text: The auth oidc callback part of your server changed in a way plain can't describe yet. /api/auth/oidc/[provider]/callback
statements.why: Correct address; true but doesn't say it fixes sign-up.

statements.text: Apply 000021_users_avatar_text.up.sql to your live database before the new code goes live (migrate ...), or the parts that use it will fail.
statements.why: Server applies embedded migrations at startup (app/migrations.go), so no manual step; without it nothing new breaks.

misses.what: Fixes SSO: first-time OIDC users with long/base64 picture (e.g. Authentik) previously hit a DB error and couldn't sign up.
Migration runs automatically on start; down migration fails if any avatar >150 chars.
New OIDC users with a non-http(s) picture now get no avatar.
